newsitem.title: USA: Vanguard launches Dallas-Phoenix route [CORRECTED 20:46 GMT].
newsitem.headline: Vanguard launches Dallas-Phoenix route [CORRECTED 20:46 GMT].

text.p: Vanguard Airlines Inc said Monday it will begin daily non-stop service between Dallas/Fort Worth and Phoenix on October 1.
Vanguard said the new route will complement its non-stop and direct service from Dallas/Fort Worth to Chicago, Wichita, Denver, Salt Lake City, Des Moines and Kansas City.
(Corrects description of service to include direct, as well as non-stop).
Vanguard said it is offering one-way fares, starting at $89, for travel on the new route between October 1 and December 18, except for blackout dates of November 22 through December 2.
Reservations must be made by midnight October 3.
